verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an official, first-party MCP server: a hosted, OAuth-protected Streamable HTTP endpoint at mcp.supabase.com/mcp, plus a local endpoint via the CLI. Its docs cover tool groups, per-connection scoping (project_ref, read_only, features), per-agent setup for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and others, and a one-command plugin that bundles the server. Community threads show the server in real use and add hardening advice (e.g. run it read-only), not evidence that connecting fails. Missing for 10: fine-grained PAT scopes (all scopes currently required), branching tools are still experimental, and no independent hands-on walkthrough of the connection flow.
